repository.name: Artery
repository.trackedCheckoutState: clean after repairing the interrupted sim0mqpp checkout

entries.reason: The shallow nested-asset fetch was bounded after the INET showcases transfer dominated the audit. The Artery CMake path uses INET_DIR/src through add_opp_target and does not add the tutorials or showcases trees to the build target. This omission means full recursive parity was not achieved.

evidence: extern/CMakeLists.txt locates INET by src/inet/package.ned and calls add_opp_target with INET as ROOT_DIR.
cmake/AddOppTarget.cmake defaults SOURCE_DIR to ROOT_DIR/src and globs C++ and message files only below that source directory.
INET's legacy Makefile contains a submodule-init rule for tutorials and showcases, but the Artery CMake integration does not invoke that Makefile path.
buildGraphCheck.conclusion: The missing INET tutorials checkout is not a compile input for the documented Artery CMake path, but it remains an explicit recursive-parity gap.

devcontainerDocumentation.officialWorkflow: Open the repository in VS Code and select Dev Container: Reopen in Container, then choose debian or arch-linux.
devcontainerDocumentation.pathDiscrepancy: No root build.py exists at this commit; the tracked executable is tools/build.py. The verbatim root-path invocation failed with exit code 127, while tools/build.py --help succeeded.

debianContainerDefinition.dependencyBuild: The Dockerfile clones and compiles OMNeT++ and SUMO from source before producing the final development image.
debianContainerDefinition.reproducibilityBoundary: The dependency tags are fixed, but the Debian base image and source tags are not pinned by content digest or commit in this definition. No image was built in this audit.

resourceComparison.triageRecommendation: Linux x86_64, Docker, at least 16 CPU cores, 64 GB RAM, and 100 GB free storage
resourceComparison.currentHost: Linux x86_64 and 24 cores; 62 GiB total RAM, 52 GiB available, and 61 GiB free storage; no container or simulator runtime

environment.boundedBuildDecision: Do not start ad hoc host installation or compile OMNeT++ and SUMO from source during this gate. The official container definition itself performs both source builds, no container runtime is present, and the host is below the preregistered free-storage envelope.

attempts.result: The SSH client timed out while extern/inet was cloning. The remote process continued temporarily, but the resulting recursive checkout was incomplete and was not counted as a successful clone.
Top-level repositories downloaded, then the operation spent about fourteen minutes in the INET showcases nested clone. The audit-owned process group was stopped to bound a non-build asset transfer.
All seven Artery top-level gitlinks checked out at the parent-recorded SHAs.
Repopulated files left absent by the interrupted recursive clone; the parent checkout then had no tracked modifications.

The controlling SSH session was stopped after a long fetch, but the remote fetch reached the exact expected showcases SHA before its process exited. Exact checkout was independently confirmed afterward.
Not fetched. It is recorded as an uninitialized nested submodule and no full recursive parity claim is made. Artery's CMake build graph was checked to establish that it is not a compile input.
Configuration stopped in CMakeLists.txt:53 because FindOmnetPP could not find OMNETPP_INCLUDE_DIR, OMNETPP_LIBRARIES, OMNETPP_MSGC, OMNETPP_ROOT, or OMNETPP_RUN. Required minimum is OMNeT++ 5.5.1.
gmake reported that no Makefile exists because CMake configuration had failed. No compilation or simulation began.
The documented root-relative helper path does not exist at the pinned commit. /tmp/artery-execution-gate-v8.xTgZry/artery/tools/build.py --help exited 0 and identifies the tracked helper.

artifacts.missingArtifactReason: Configuration failed before any build target was generated, so no binary, container digest, SUMO process, OMNeT++ event, scalar/vector output, or deterministic example trace exists.

exampleResult.primaryFailure: OMNeT++ was not installed or discoverable; CMake required at least 5.5.1 and could not locate its headers, libraries, message compiler, root, or runner.
exampleResult.downstreamTargetFailure: run_example exited 2 because configuration had not generated a Makefile.
exampleResult.interpretation: This is an environment and dependency failure before Artery compilation. It is not evidence that the official example, Artery model, or candidate controller fails when run in the supported pinned environment. It also is not a successful reproduction.

blockers.evidence: command -v opp_run exited 1 and CMake configure exited 1 with all required OmnetPP discovery fields missing.
blockers.minimumResolution: Provide OMNeT++ 5.6.2 through the official Debian devcontainer or an equivalent verified installation.

blockers.evidence: command -v sumo exited 1; official install documentation requires sumo to be launchable for the example.
blockers.minimumResolution: Provide SUMO v1_21_0 as pinned by the official Debian container definition.

blockers.evidence: docker, podman, devcontainer, and vagrant checks all exited 1.
blockers.minimumResolution: Provision Docker plus a Dev Container client, or reproduce the Dockerfile's dependencies on a separate supported Linux host.

blockers.evidence: The official Dockerfile compiles OMNeT++ and SUMO from source; the host has 61 GiB free, below the triage's 100 GB free-storage envelope.
blockers.minimumResolution: Use a host satisfying the frozen resource envelope and retain dependency build logs and the final image digest.

blockers.evidence: extern/inet/tutorials remains uninitialized at expected SHA 3e05ed7c46b6e4cadc937627f83c4f32155b82dc.
blockers.minimumResolution: Fetch the tutorials gitlink before claiming full recursive parity; it is not required to reach the Artery CMake compile graph.

blockers.evidence: The repository provides Dockerfiles, not a verified prebuilt image digest; debian:bookworm and dependency tags are not content-addressed pins.
blockers.minimumResolution: Build once in the approved environment, record the resulting image digest, and freeze any resolved upstream commit or package manifest needed for independent reruns.

blockers.evidence: docs/devcontainers.md says ./build.py -cb, but only tools/build.py is tracked at the pinned commit.
blockers.minimumResolution: Invoke tools/build.py explicitly or use the direct documented CMake commands; do not claim the verbatim helper command succeeded.

verified: The official riebl/artery remote and requested commit exist, and origin master resolved to that exact SHA at checkedAt.
All seven top-level Artery submodules were checked out at the exact gitlink SHAs.
The root COPYING file is the GNU GPL version 2 text and project documentation labels Artery GPL version 2.
The official direct CMake build/example documentation, run_example target definition, and Debian devcontainer source definition were inspected at the pinned commit.
The Debian definition selects OMNeT++ 5.6.2 and SUMO 1.21 by source tags.
notVerified: Full recursive submodule parity, because extern/inet/tutorials was deliberately left uninitialized as a non-build nested asset.
A built container image or image digest.
Successful CMake configuration, compilation, official-example execution, or deterministic event trace.
Any candidate controller implementation, cross-sender semantic derivative, oscillation, starvation, fairness, or stability boundary.
Any perception-quality effect, public perception checkpoint, PC5 behavior, Uu behavior, or deployed-system result.
A complete transitive license determination for all submodules.
claimBoundary.allowedConclusion: The pinned official Artery source contract is available and its core top-level assets are internally consistent, but this host did not pass the official-example execution gate.
claimBoundary.forbiddenConclusion: Do not describe Artery, OMNeT++, SUMO, run_example, or the coupled-rate candidate as executed or reproduced from this audit.

verdictReason: Repository, commit, core submodules, root license, documentation, and container definition pass static verification. The mandatory official example did not configure or run, full recursive parity was not claimed, and no event trace or container digest exists. The candidate cannot advance past the execution gate on this evidence.

preconditions: Use a Linux x86_64 host with Docker or a compatible Dev Container runtime, at least 64 GB RAM, and at least 100 GB free storage.
Retain the same Artery commit and initialize every recursive gitlink before claiming full parity.
officialSequence: Open the repository with the official Debian devcontainer definition using Dev Container: Reopen in Container.
requiredEvidence: Resolved container image digest and dependency build log
Recursive submodule status with no '+', '-', or 'U' prefixes
One deterministic OMNeT++ event or scalar/vector trace proving the example actually ran with SUMO

nextAction.promotionRule: Change the gate to pass only after the official example runs and all required evidence is independently checked. Do not begin the coupled controller implementation before that point.
nextAction.killRule: If the official example still cannot be reproduced within the dossier's three-working-day window on a supported provisioned host, apply the candidate kill criterion rather than substituting a synthetic success.
